groups.label: Payments
items: When do I pay the membership?
When you sign up, for one year up front. It renews automatically and we remind you 15 days before.
When do I get my royalties?
Every time we publish an official statement, following the payment calendar of the societies and administration partners. We let you know by email and in the app.
Why do royalties take months to arrive?
Platforms and societies report and pay late; that’s normal across the industry. On Pluma you can see what stage each payment is at.
How do I get paid, and in what currency?
By transfer through Wise or Payoneer, in US dollars (USD). The minimum withdrawal is USD 20.
What is the commission charged on?
On the royalties Pluma collects for your songs: 20% on Socio and 15% on Pro. No other hidden fees.
Do you withhold taxes?
It depends on your country and where the income comes from. We give you withholding certificates for your tax return. [verificar]

groups.label: Splits
items: What is a split?
The percentage of a song that belongs to each writer. It sets how much each one gets paid.
Do my co-writers have to be on Pluma?
No. They can sign their share from a link without subscribing. Pluma only administers the share of writers who are members.
What if a co-writer doesn’t sign or disagrees?
The song is paused and its payments are held until it’s resolved. We help you mediate.
Can I change a split later?
Yes, but every co-writer has to sign the new version.

groups.label: Agreement and ownership
items: Does Pluma take my songs?
No. You keep 100% ownership. Pluma only administers and collects for you.
How long is the agreement and how do I leave?
[Term and exit conditions to be defined]. When you leave, we hand over your catalog and settle the royalties in progress.
I’m already with a collecting society. Can I join?
Yes. Pluma works alongside your society; you’ll keep collecting your writer’s share.
What if I’m under 18?
You can join with your parent’s or legal guardian’s signature.

groups.label: Network
items: Can someone steal my idea if I upload a demo?
Your demos only play inside Pluma, with an audio watermark and every play logged, and every song has a dated proof of authorship.
How does a collaboration work?
You post what you need or apply to a request. Once accepted, the split is agreed and, when the song is ready, you both sign in one tap.

groups.label: Sync
items: How does my music get into a movie or an ad?
You add your songs to the sync catalog (Pro plan). Supervisors and agencies find them, or you pitch them to open briefs.
Can they use my song without my permission?
No. You approve every license before it’s signed.
How much does Pluma take on sync?
30% of the license.
What does one-stop mean?
When you also control the recording (the master), the client licenses the song and the master with one signature.

groups.label: Plans
items: What’s the difference between Socio and Pro?
Pro includes sync, the A&R catalog, advanced analytics, a featured profile and a lower commission (15% instead of 20%).
Can I switch plans?
You can upgrade to Pro anytime by paying the difference. If you move down to Socio, the change applies at the end of your year.
Is there a free plan?
No. Every Pluma member has an active plan, which keeps the community serious and professional.

groups.label: Artificial intelligence
items: Can I register songs made with AI?
You must declare whether you used AI when you register the song. [Policy to be defined].
Does Pluma use my songs to train AI?
No, not without your express permission.
